articles.title: pdefa added to PyPI
articles.summary: This describes a new CPU inference engine optimized for efficient machine learning tasks, including image processing (PNG/JPEG) and object detection (YOLO). Built in C++20 with AVX2 SIMD for high performance, it incorporates an ONNX engine converter and boasts zero Python dependencies, utilizing ctypes for its Python layer. This technical innovation focuses on delivering high-speed, standalone AI computation capabilities.

articles.title: Selected Articles: Lithuania and Other NATO Members Plotting Blockade of Kaliningrad
articles.summary: Reports indicate Lithuania and other Baltic NATO members are planning a blockade of Kaliningrad, a Russian exclave. This potential action would significantly escalate regional tensions, impacting critical supply lines and challenging Russian access. Such a move underscores ongoing geopolitical friction and could have profound implications for security dynamics between NATO and Russia, demanding close attention from a defence perspective.
